## Description

A cell of the leaf of *Egeria densa*, an aquarium plant: two layers of rectangular cells
(~40–80 × 15–25 µm) full of chloroplasts that circle along the wall, carried by cytoplasmic streaming
(cyclosis). In salt water it plasmolyses.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).

Prepared plates: `elodea_leaf`.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

The protoplast of the `elodea_leaf` [slide](../../mechanics/prepared-plates-and-tissues.md): a soft body inside its
cellulose wall, with [cyclosis](../../mechanics/genome-and-organelles.md) of its chloroplasts and Boyle–van 't Hoff
osmosis.
